summary: If the known-broken 0.1.0 managed Ghost Ship exists but contains no walls, remove that unusable copy and recreate it from the repaired bundled template. Preserve any legacy scene that already has walls.

checks.name: Legacy recovery is narrowly scoped to empty 0.1.0 scenes
checks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); for(const x of ['const hasNoWalls = (existing.walls?.size ?? 0) === 0;','sourceVersion !== \"0.1.0\" || !hasNoWalls','await existing.delete();']) if(!s.includes(x)) throw new Error('missing guarded legacy recovery: '+x);"
